what: R129 air control and landing tiers (P1-FL07; docs/research/fun-tracks.md R14-R16) on the Feel Lab's canyon leap: a Cruz Missile takes the kicker flat out down its middle at 22 m/s, lifts off the throttle at the lip (tick 66) and flies the gap; it floors it again once down (tick 260). The three fixtures fly the same jump three ways (air-pitch-neutral, -down, -up). Nose up: a sixth of a second of brake in the air (ticks 90-110) lifts the nose instead, and it comes down tail first about 30 degrees off the landing: a bad landing, which loses speed (slower than it took off, where the neutral run is faster).
